Definition: to repose, i.e. desist from exertion; used in many implied relations (causative, figurative or specific)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cease, desist, rest; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cease; 1a2) to rest, desist (from labour); 1b) (Niphal) to cease; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to cease, put an end to; 1c2) to exterminate, destroy; 1c3) to cause to desist from; 1c4) to remove; 1c5) to cause to fail; 2) (Qal) to keep or observe the sabbath
